logger.doc:name: Log error
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default 'N/A') ++ "] File processing failed for: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ ". Error: " ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error')]

http:request.doc:name: Update Run Status to FAILED
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { parsedCount: vars.parsedCount default 0, insertedCount: vars.insertedCount default 0, updatedCount: vars.updatedCount default 0, rejectedCount: vars.rejectedCount default 0, rejectPercent: vars.rejectPercent default 0.0, runStatus: "FAILED", rejectFilePath: vars.rejectFilePath default null }]

on-error-continue.doc:name: Ignore DB update error on failure

logger.doc:name: Log DB update fail
logger.message: Could not update run status in database on error

logger.doc:name: Log notification fail
logger.message: Could not send failure notification email

choice.doc:name: Is File Trigger For Error Move?

logger.doc:name: Log move failure
logger.message: Could not move file to error directory

logger.doc:name: Log File Intake Done on Error
logger.message: File intake flow completed error handling.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { runId: vars.runId, fileName: vars.fileName, fileFormat: vars.fileFormat, runStatus: vars.runStatus, declaredCount: vars.declaredCount, parsedCount: vars.parsedCount, insertedCount: vars.insertedCount, updatedCount: vars.updatedCount, rejectedCount: vars.rejectedCount, rejectPercent: vars.rejectPercent, rejectFilePath: vars.rejectFilePath }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var ext = lower((vars.fileName splitBy ".")[-1] default "") var contentStr = if (vars.rawContent is Binary) (vars.rawContent as String default "") else if (vars.rawContent is String) vars.rawContent else "" --- if (ext == "xml" or (contentStr startsWith "<")) "XML" else "CSV"

logger.doc:name: Log run start
logger.message: #["Starting Run [" ++ vars.runId ++ "] for file: " ++ vars.fileName ++ " (" ++ vars.fileFormat ++ ") Checksum: " ++ vars.fileChecksum]

logger.doc:name: Log duplicate file
logger.message: #["Duplicate file detected: " ++ vars.fileName ++ " with checksum " ++ vars.fileChecksum ++ ". Skipping import."]

http:request.doc:name: Create Run Record
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { runId: vars.runId, fileName: vars.fileName, fileFormat: vars.fileFormat, fileChecksum: vars.fileChecksum, declaredCount: null, runStatus: "STARTED", correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Declared Count Mismatch
raise-error.description: #["Declared record count (" ++ vars.declaredCount ++ ") does not match parsed count (" ++ vars.parsedCount ++ ")"]

logger.doc:name: Log empty file
logger.message: #["[" ++ vars.runId ++ "] Empty file received with 0 records. Completing gracefully."]

http:request.doc:name: Update Run Empty
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { parsedCount: 0, insertedCount: 0, updatedCount: 0, rejectedCount: 0, rejectPercent: 0.0, runStatus: "SUCCESS_EMPTY", rejectFilePath: null }]

logger.doc:name: Log validation counts
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] Parsed: " ++ (vars.parsedCount as String default '0') ++ ", Valid: " ++ (sizeOf(vars.validRecords default []) as String) ++ ", Rejected: " ++ (vars.rejectedCount as String default '0') ++ " (" ++ (vars.rejectPercent as String default '0') ++ "%)"]

logger.doc:name: Log threshold exceeded
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] Rejection percentage (" ++ (vars.rejectPercent as String default '0') ++ "%) exceeds configured threshold. Aborting persistence."]

http:request.doc:name: Save Aborted Rejects
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- vars.invalidRecords map { run_id: vars.runId, record_index: $.recordIndex, employee_id: $.employeeId, reject_code: $.rejectCode, reject_reason: $.rejectReason }]

http:request.doc:name: Update Run Aborted
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { parsedCount: vars.parsedCount, insertedCount: 0, updatedCount: 0, rejectedCount: vars.rejectedCount, rejectPercent: vars.rejectPercent, runStatus: "ABORTED_THRESHOLD", rejectFilePath: vars.rejectFilePath }]

http:request.doc:name: Save Rejects to DB
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- vars.invalidRecords map { run_id: vars.runId, record_index: $.recordIndex, employee_id: $.employeeId, reject_code: $.rejectCode, reject_reason: $.rejectReason }]

set-variable.value: #[import dw::core::Arrays output application/java --- Arrays::divideBy(vars.validRecords, (p('batch.size') default '50') as Number)]

http:request.doc:name: Persist Employee Batch
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map ((item) -> { employee_id: item.employeeId, first_name: item.firstName, last_name: item.lastName, date_of_birth: item.dateOfBirth, date_of_joining: item.dateOfJoining, official_email: item.officialEmail, mobile: item.mobile, department_key: item.departmentKey, designation: item.designation, grade: item.grade, location_key: item.locationKey, employment_type: upper(item.employmentType), manager_key: if (isEmpty(item.managerId)) null else item.managerId, employee_status: "ACTIVE", source_run_id: vars.runId })]

logger.doc:name: Log batch progress
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] Processed batch " ++ (vars.counter as String default '1') ++ " of " ++ (sizeOf(vars.batches default []) as String)]

http:request.doc:name: Update Run Completed
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { parsedCount: vars.parsedCount, insertedCount: vars.insertedCount, updatedCount: vars.updatedCount, rejectedCount: vars.rejectedCount, rejectPercent: vars.rejectPercent, runStatus: vars.runStatus, rejectFilePath: vars.rejectFilePath }]

logger.doc:name: Log run finished
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] Completed with status " ++ (vars.runStatus default '') ++ ". Inserted: " ++ (vars.insertedCount as String default '0') ++ ", Updated: " ++ (vars.updatedCount as String default '0') ++ ", Rejected: " ++ (vars.rejectedCount as String default '0')]

logger.doc:name: Log reject file written
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] Reject file written to: " ++ (vars.rejectFilePath default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log SMTP warning
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] SMTP send failed. Notification preserved in notifications directory."]

logger.doc:name: Log email sent
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[" ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ "] Summary notification generated: " ++ (vars.emailSubject default '')]
